Doe"} ### Current appointment Assistant Professor Department of Economics Northwestern Policy Institute ::: ::: ## Research interests - Labor economics and wage inequality - Public finance and tax policy - Human capital, education, and social mobility - Applied causal inference and policy evaluation - Development economics and urban policy ## Selected recent work ::: {.grid} ::: {.gutter} ### [Labor Market Frictions and the Geography of Employment](research.qmd) Examines how commuting constraints and local labor demand shocks affect job matching, wages, and labor supply across metropolitan labor markets. ### [Public Finance in the Age of Automation](research.qmd) Studies the distributional consequences of tax policy when technological change alters the skill composition of work. ### [Education Policy and Long-run Mobility](research.qmd) Uses administrative data to evaluate how tuition subsidies and academic support programs alter graduation and earnings trajectories. ::: ::: ## News - 2026: New working paper on wage dispersion and regional labor markets. - 2025: Invited speaker, Midwest Economics Association annual meeting. - 2024: Grant awarded for study of public insurance and labor supply.
